description: EPANET INP layouts support a study of interfaces between water-distribution and transport networks. This resource is provided by Abdel-Mottaleb, Noha; Zhang, Qiong. Its method is not tied to one place; geographic inputs and simulation resolution depend on the user configuration. The provider lists ZIP formats or archive containers, accessible through the linked landing page. Licence: CC-BY-4.0. The public page or repository can be accessed free of charge. Limitation: The archive contains network specifications, so a model classification is more useful than treating it as measured data. For simulation, it can support model-based scenario analysis. Related catalogue record: model-epanet. The relationship follows the named method or resource; it does not certify file compatibility.
